mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: MacOS X 10.11 (El Capitan) or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 (2.3 GHz or better) or Apple M1
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 6000 / Radeon R9 M370X (or equivalent)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Standard macOS-compatible
  • Additional Notes: Headset Required
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: MacOS X 12 (Monterey) or later
  • Processor: Apple M1 Pro / M2 or Intel Core i7 (3.0 GHz or better)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M1 Pro/Max GPU or AMD Radeon Pro 5500M (or better)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Standard macOS-compatible
  • Additional Notes: Headset Required
